question: What event at the time of bodily death is being indicated to the goddess?
premises: The moment of the body's fall is specified.
The skull is said to be pierced at that time.
inference: At the fall of the body, the skull is pierced then.
uncertainties: The doctrinal consequence of the skull being pierced is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: O Goddess, when the body falls, then the skull is pierced.
